text: Mark me: Heb. Look unto me
safe from fear: Heb. are peace from fear
his iniquity: That is, the punishment of his iniquity
in his full strength: Heb. in his very perfection, or in the strength of his perfection
the dwelling places: Heb. the tent of the tabernacles of the wicked
the day of wrath: Heb. the day of wraths
grave: Heb. graves | remain in the tomb: Heb. watch in the heap
